title: sibliths raindance
description:
Change the weather with a hop and a jump!

Forward, back, left, right, sneak and jump, or you can freestyle!
body:
With this mod you can do a "raindance" to change the weather, if its clear and you do the dance it will rain with a chance to thunder, if its raining or thundering when yoiu do the dance it will set the weather to clear!

forward, back, left, right, sneak and jump to change the weather, or any freestyle combination will all the correct key strokes.
